"""
RAG Scene 01 — 2D Molecule: Morphine structural walk-through
Feature: MMoleculeObject / NamedMolecule
"""
from pathlib import Path
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import MMoleculeObject, NamedMolecule

config.renderer = "cairo"

HERE = Path(__file__).absolute().parent.parent
MOL_DIR = HERE / "examples" / "molecule_files" / "mol_files"
MORPHINE_2D = MOL_DIR / "morphine_2d.mol"

class MorphineStructureScene(Scene):
    """Rich 2D molecule scene: morphine structural formula with build-up animation."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0d1b2a"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        subtitle = Text("C₁₇H₁₉NO₃  •  MW 285.34 g/mol", font_size=20, color="#94a3b8")

        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)

        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Load 2-D molecule ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        molecule = MMoleculeObject.molecule_from_file(filepath=MORPHINE_2D)
        molecule.scale(0.9).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.4)

        self.play(Create(molecule), run_time=2.5)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Highlight the nitrogen atom area with a glowing circle ────────────
        highlight_ring = Circle(radius=0.55, color="#f97316", stroke_width=3)

        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.18, aligned_edge=LEFT)

"""
RAG Scene 02 — Graph Molecule: Acetone graph with/without labels + bond type reveal
Feature: GraphMolecule
"""
from pathlib import Path
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import GraphMolecule

config.renderer = "cairo"

HERE = Path(__file__).absolute().parent.parent
MOL_DIR = HERE / "examples" / "molecule_files" / "mol_files"
ACETONE_2D = MOL_DIR / "acetone_2d.mol"


class AcetoneGraphScene(Scene):
    """Graph-molecule scene: acetone drawn as a Manim Graph, atom labels revealed step-by-step."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#111827"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Acetone — Graph Representation", font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        formula_label = Text("CH₃COCH₃ · Ketone group", font_size=20, color="#60a5fa")
        header = VGroup(title, formula_label).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.12)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(formula_label, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Load unlabelled graph molecule ─────────────────────────────────────
        mol_plain = GraphMolecule.molecule_from_file(filepath=ACETONE_2D)
        mol_plain.scale(1.6).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.2)

        self.play(Create(mol_plain), run_time=2.0)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Annotate: draw a brace + "carbonyl carbon" label ─────────────────
        center_pos = mol_plain.get_center()
        carbonyl_dot = Dot(point=center_pos + LEFT * 0.05, color="#fbbf24", radius=0.12)
        carbonyl_label = Text("Carbonyl C", font_size=18, color="#fbbf24")
        carbonyl_label.next_to(carbonyl_dot, RIGHT, buff=0.2)

        self.play(GrowFromCenter(carbonyl_dot), Write(carbonyl_label), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Transform to labelled version ─────────────────────────────────────
        step_text = Text("→ Reveal atom labels", font_size=20, color="#a78bfa")
        step_text.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.6)
        self.play(Write(step_text), run_time=0.6)

        mol_labeled = GraphMolecule.molecule_from_file(filepath=ACETONE_2D, label=True)
        mol_labeled.scale(1.6).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.2)

        self.play(
            Transform(mol_plain, mol_labeled),
            FadeOut(carbonyl_dot),
            FadeOut(carbonyl_label),
            run_time=1.5,
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Info panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        info_lines = VGroup(
            Text("Atoms: C=3, O=1, H=6", font_size=16, color="#94a3b8"),
            Text("Bonds: 2× C–C, 1× C=O, 6× C–H", font_size=16, color="#94a3b8"),
            Text("Graph nodes = atoms, edges = bonds", font_size=16, color="#6b7280"),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.14, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        info_box = SurroundingRectangle(info_lines, color="#1f2937", fill_color="#1f2937",
                                        fill_opacity=0.7, buff=0.18, corner_radius=0.1)
        info_panel = VGroup(info_box, info_lines)
        info_panel.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.3).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.35)

        self.play(FadeIn(info_panel, shift=UP * 0.3), FadeOut(step_text), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Final scale-in zoom ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        self.play(
            mol_plain.animate.scale(1.2).move_to(RIGHT * 0.8 + DOWN * 0.1),
            run_time=1.0,
        )
        self.wait(0.8)

"""
RAG Scene 03 — Periodic Table Element: MElementObject spotlight + mini-table layout
Feature: MElementObject (from CSV), PeriodicTable (mini layout)
"""
from pathlib import Path
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import MElementObject

config.renderer = "cairo"

HERE = Path(__file__).absolute().parent.parent
CSV = HERE / "examples" / "element_files" / "Elementos.csv"

# Atomic numbers we'll feature (C, N, O, Fe, Au)
FEATURED = [6, 7, 8, 26, 79]
ELEM_NAMES = {6: "Carbon", 7: "Nitrogen", 8: "Oxygen", 26: "Iron", 79: "Gold"}
ELEM_COLORS = {
    6: ("#909090", "#58C4DD"),
    7: ("#3050f8", "#58C4DD"),
    8: ("#ff0d0d", "#58C4DD"),
    26: ("#e06633", "#ffd700"),
    79: ("#ffd123", "#ff8c00"),
}


class PeriodicElementSpotlight(Scene):
    """Showcases MElementObject tiles for 5 elements, reveals them one-by-one
    with annotations, then arranges them into a mini horizontal periodic strip."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0a0a1a"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Periodic Table Elements", font_size=38, color=WHITE)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.2)

        # ── Big spotlight element: Carbon ─────────────────────────────────────
        carbon = MElementObject.from_csv_file_data(
            filename=CSV,
            atomic_number=6,
            fill_colors=("#909090", "#58C4DD"),
        )
        carbon.scale(2.0).move_to(ORIGIN)

        spotlight_label = Text("Carbon — element 6", font_size=24, color="#909090")
        spotlight_label.next_to(carbon, DOWN, buff=0.4)

        self.play(FadeIn(carbon, scale=0.4), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(Write(spotlight_label), run_time=0.7)
        self.play(Indicate(carbon, scale_factor=1.1, color="#fbbf24"), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Shrink carbon and build the strip ─────────────────────────────────
        self.play(FadeOut(spotlight_label), run_time=0.4)

        # Build all 5 element tiles
        tiles = VGroup()
        for an in FEATURED:
            fill_col, grad_col = ELEM_COLORS[an]
            tile = MElementObject.from_csv_file_data(
                filename=CSV,
                atomic_number=an,
                fill_colors=(fill_col, grad_col),
            )
            tiles.add(tile)

        tiles.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.35)
        tiles.scale(0.85).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.1)

        # Animate carbon shrinking into strip position and others appearing
        target_carbon = tiles[0]
        self.play(
            carbon.animate.scale(0.425).move_to(target_carbon.get_center()),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.remove(carbon)
        self.add(tiles[0])

        for i in range(1, len(tiles)):
            self.play(FadeIn(tiles[i], shift=UP * 0.3), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Add element name labels below each tile ───────────────────────────
        name_labels = VGroup()
        for i, an in enumerate(FEATURED):
            lbl = Text(ELEM_NAMES[an], font_size=14, color="#94a3b8")
            lbl.next_to(tiles[i], DOWN, buff=0.15)
            name_labels.add(lbl)

        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Write(l) for l in name_labels], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Highlight the metals (Fe, Au) ─────────────────────────────────────
        metals_label = Text("Transition Metals →", font_size=18, color="#fbbf24")
        metals_label.next_to(tiles[3], UP, buff=0.3)
        metal_box = SurroundingRectangle(
            VGroup(tiles[3], tiles[4]), color="#fbbf24", buff=0.18, corner_radius=0.08
        )
        self.play(Create(metal_box), Write(metals_label), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Closing annotation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        closing = Text("MElementObject — rendered from Elementos.csv",
                       font_size=15, color="#374151")
        closing.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        self.play(FadeIn(closing), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(1.0)

"""
RAG Scene 04 — Bohr Atom: build up a Silicon Bohr diagram, animate orbital reveal,
add shell labels and electron counts.
Feature: BohrAtom
"""
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import BohrAtom

config.renderer = "cairo"


class SiliconBohrAtomScene(Scene):
    """Rich Bohr-atom scene: silicon (Z=14) built up shell by shell with labels,
    legend, and an electron-orbit pulse animation."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#050a14"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Silicon (Si) — Bohr Model", font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        subtitle = Text("Z = 14  •  Electron config: 2, 8, 4", font_size=20, color="#7dd3fc")
        header = VGroup(title, subtitle).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.12)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Build the Bohr diagram ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        # BohrAtom(e=14, p=14, n=10) — silicon has 14 protons, ~10 neutrons
        bohr = BohrAtom(
            e=14, p=14, n=10,
            orbit_color="#334155",
            electron_color="#38bdf8",
            proton_color="#ef4444",
            neutron_color="#94a3b8",
        )
        bohr.scale(1.0).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.15)

        self.play(GrowFromCenter(bohr), run_time=2.0)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Pulse / Indicate the whole diagram ───────────────────────────────
        self.play(Indicate(bohr, scale_factor=1.08, color="#fbbf24"), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Shell label callouts ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        shell_data = [
            ("K shell (n=1): 2e⁻", LEFT * 4.2 + UP * 0.6, "#fde68a"),
            ("L shell (n=2): 8e⁻", LEFT * 4.2 + DOWN * 0.6, "#86efac"),
            ("M shell (n=3): 4e⁻", RIGHT * 3.5 + UP * 0.0, "#f9a8d4"),
        ]
        callouts = VGroup()
        for text_str, pos, color in shell_data:
            lbl = Text(text_str, font_size=16, color=color)
            lbl.move_to(pos)
            callouts.add(lbl)

        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c, shift=RIGHT * 0.3) for c in callouts], lag_ratio=0.35),
                  run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Legend: proton / neutron / electron ──────────────────────────────
        legend_items = VGroup(
            VGroup(Dot(color="#ef4444", radius=0.1), Text("Proton (+)", font_size=15, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
            VGroup(Dot(color="#94a3b8", radius=0.1), Text("Neutron (0)", font_size=15, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
            VGroup(Dot(color="#38bdf8", radius=0.1), Text("Electron (–)", font_size=15, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.18, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        legend_box = SurroundingRectangle(legend_items, color="#1e3a5f", fill_color="#0f172a",
                                          fill_opacity=0.85, buff=0.2, corner_radius=0.1)
        legend = VGroup(legend_box, legend_items)
        legend.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.3).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.55)

        self.play(FadeIn(legend, shift=LEFT * 0.2), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Zoom into nucleus ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        nucleus_spotlight = Circle(radius=0.55, color="#fbbf24", stroke_width=2.5)
        nucleus_spotlight.move_to(bohr.get_center())
        nucleus_label = Text("Nucleus\n14p + 10n", font_size=14, color="#fbbf24")
        nucleus_label.next_to(nucleus_spotlight, DOWN, buff=0.15)

        self.play(Create(nucleus_spotlight), Write(nucleus_label), run_time=0.9)
        self.play(Flash(bohr.get_center(), color="#fbbf24", num_lines=12, line_length=0.35), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.8)

        # ── Final annotation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        closing = Text("Semiconductor — 4 valence electrons", font_size=17, color="#64748b")
        closing.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        self.play(Write(closing), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(1.0)

"""
RAG Scene 05 — Chemical Formula showcase: ChemicalFormula, NamedFormula, ComplexFormula
Feature: ChemicalFormula, NamedFormula, ComplexFormula, NamedComplexFormula
"""
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import ChemicalFormula, NamedFormula, ComplexFormula, NamedComplexFormula

config.renderer = "cairo"


class ChemicalFormulasShowcase(Scene):
    """Animated gallery of chemical formula types: simple, named, and complex formulas
    with color coding for ionic species and transition animations."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f172a"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Chemical Formulas", font_size=38, color=WHITE)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.2)

        # ── SECTION 1: Simple ChemicalFormula ────────────────────────────────
        sec1_label = Text("1. Simple Ionic Formula", font_size=20, color="#60a5fa")
        sec1_label.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 1.5)

        h2so4 = ChemicalFormula(
            "H2SO4",
            metal_color="#ffffff",
            non_metal_color="#60a5fa",
            oxygen_color="#ef4444",
        )
        h2so4.scale(1.8).next_to(sec1_label, DOWN, buff=0.3).align_to(sec1_label, LEFT)

        nacl = ChemicalFormula(
            "NaCl",
            metal_color="#fbbf24",
            non_metal_color="#34d399",
        )
        nacl.scale(1.8).next_to(h2so4, RIGHT, buff=1.0)

        self.play(FadeIn(sec1_label, shift=RIGHT * 0.3), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(Write(h2so4), run_time=0.9)
        self.play(Write(nacl), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── SECTION 2: NamedFormula ───────────────────────────────────────────
        sec2_label = Text("2. Named Formula (ionic salt)", font_size=20, color="#a78bfa")
        sec2_label.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 0.1)

        named = NamedFormula(
            metal_name="Sodium",
            non_metal_name="Chloride",
            formula="NaCl",
            metal_color="#fbbf24",
            non_metal_color="#34d399",
        )
        named.scale(1.3).next_to(sec2_label, DOWN, buff=0.3).align_to(sec2_label, LEFT)

        self.play(FadeIn(sec2_label, shift=RIGHT * 0.3), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(named, scale=0.5), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(Indicate(named, color="#fbbf24", scale_factor=1.08), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── SECTION 3: ComplexFormula ─────────────────────────────────────────
        sec3_label = Text("3. Complex Formula (coloured ions)", font_size=20, color="#f472b6")
        sec3_label.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 1.4)

        complex_f = ComplexFormula({
            "Fe": "#ef4444",
            "²⁺": "#fca5a5",
            "SO₄": "#60a5fa",
            "²⁻": "#93c5fd",
        })
        complex_f.scale(1.5).next_to(sec3_label, DOWN, buff=0.25).align_to(sec3_label, LEFT)

        self.play(FadeIn(sec3_label, shift=RIGHT * 0.3), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(Write(complex_f), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── SECTION 4: NamedComplexFormula ────────────────────────────────────
        sec4_label = Text("4. Named Complex Formula", font_size=20, color="#34d399")
        sec4_label.next_to(sec3_label, RIGHT, buff=2.5).align_to(sec3_label, UP)

        named_complex = NamedComplexFormula(
            name_dict={"Iron(II) sulfate": "#34d399"},
            formula_dict={"FeSO₄": "#f9a8d4"},
        )
        named_complex.scale(1.1).next_to(sec4_label, DOWN, buff=0.25).align_to(sec4_label, LEFT)

        self.play(FadeIn(sec4_label, shift=LEFT * 0.3), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(named_complex, scale=0.6), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.4)

config.renderer = "opengl"


class POrbitalScene(ThreeDScene):
    """Rich 3D p-orbital scene: render a px orbital, add axis labels and text
    overlays, then camera-orbit around it. Uses OpenGL renderer."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#070d1a"

        title = Text("p-Orbital (l=1, m=0)", font_size=30, color=WHITE)

        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title)
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)

        # ── Reference axes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        axes = ThreeDAxes(
            x_range=[-3, 3, 1], y_range=[-3, 3, 1], z_range=[-3, 3, 1],

        for lbl in [x_lbl, y_lbl, z_lbl]:

"""
RAG Scene 07 — 3D Molecule: Morphine in 3D space, rotating camera
Feature: ThreeDMolecule (OpenGL ThreeDScene)
"""
from pathlib import Path
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import ThreeDMolecule

config.renderer = "opengl"

HERE = Path(__file__).absolute().parent.parent
MOL_DIR = HERE / "examples" / "molecule_files" / "mol_files"
CSV = HERE / "examples" / "element_files" / "Elementos.csv"
MORPHINE_3D = MOL_DIR / "morphine_3d.mol"


class Morphine3DScene(ThreeDScene):
    """Rich 3D molecule scene: morphine rendered as a ball-and-stick 3D structure
    with color-coded CPK atoms, rotating camera orbit, and fixed-frame labels.
    Uses ThreeDMolecule.molecule_from_file with CSV-based CPK coloring."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#020b18"

        # ── Load the 3D molecule with CPK colors from CSV ─────────────────────
        molecule = ThreeDMolecule.molecule_from_file(
            filepath=MORPHINE_3D,
            source_csv=str(CSV),
        )
        molecule.scale(0.7).move_to(ORIGIN)

        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=70 * DEGREES, theta=-60 * DEGREES)

        # ── Title overlay (add directly — no Write in OpenGL 3D) ─────────────
        title = Text("Morphine — 3D Ball-and-Stick Model", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        title.to_corner(UL, buff=0.3)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title)

        # ── Add molecule and wait ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        self.add(molecule)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Slow camera rotation for a full 360 look ─────────────────────────
        self.begin_ambient_camera_rotation(rate=0.35)
        self.wait(4.5)
        self.stop_ambient_camera_rotation()
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Tilt for top-down view ────────────────────────────────────────────
        self.move_camera(phi=30 * DEGREES, theta=0 * DEGREES, run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Zoom-out camera move to show the full structure ───────────────────
        self.move_camera(phi=60 * DEGREES, theta=45 * DEGREES, run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── CPK color legend (fixed frame) ────────────────────────────────────
        legend = VGroup(
            VGroup(Dot(color="#909090", radius=0.10), Text("Carbon", font_size=14, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
            VGroup(Dot(color="#ff0d0d", radius=0.10), Text("Oxygen", font_size=14, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
            VGroup(Dot(color="#3050f8", radius=0.10), Text("Nitrogen", font_size=14, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
            VGroup(Dot(color="#eeeeee", radius=0.10), Text("Hydrogen", font_size=14, color="#94a3b8")).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        legend_bg = BackgroundRectangle(legend, color="#0a1628", fill_opacity=0.8, buff=0.2)
        legend_group = VGroup(legend_bg, legend)
        legend_group.to_corner(UR, buff=0.3)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(legend_group)
        self.play(FadeIn(legend_group), run_time=0.6)
        self.wait(0.2)

        # ── Resume slow rotation from top angle ──────────────────────────────
        self.begin_ambient_camera_rotation(rate=0.25)

        # ── Bottom info bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(info)
